findings.issue: Manager personnel number comes from the query string, not IUserContext; any caller can list another manager's reports' leave.
findings.evidence: TeamLeaveCalendarQuery.ManagerPersonnelNumber is bound via [FromQuery] (Controller:35) and used as the Workers filter at Service:52-54 and in the cache key (Service:44). IUserContext is never injected.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user reads any manager's team leave by passing a different ManagerPersonnelNumber (cross-user data leak).
findings.fix: Inject IUserContext and use its PersonnelNumber; drop the field from the query.

findings.issue: Queries Workers directly (outside WorkerService / documented exceptions) filtered by ManagerPersonnelNumber instead of PersonnelNumber.
findings.evidence: _d365Service.QueryRecordsAsync(D365EntityNames.Workers, filter: ManagerPersonnelNumber eq ...) at Service:52-54; CLAUDE.md D-07/D-08 forbid this and the exception list does not include this service.
findings.impact: Breaks identity-entity ownership; Workers filter on a non-PersonnelNumber field is explicitly forbidden.
findings.fix: Resolve direct reports through an owning service or approved batch pattern filtered by PersonnelNumber.

findings.issue: One D365 LeaveApprovedRequests call per direct report inside a foreach loop.
findings.evidence: foreach over reports (Service:64) awaits _d365Service.QueryRecordsAsync(D365EntityNames.LeaveApprovedRequests, ...) at Service:78 each iteration.
findings.impact: N+1 D365 calls per request (hundreds for a large team) risks 429 service protection throttling.
findings.fix: Use BatchRequestBuilder or a single filter over all report personnel numbers.

findings.issue: catch (Exception) swallows every D365 error, including D365ClaimsChallengeException, and silently skips the worker.
findings.evidence: try/catch (Exception ex) around the D365 call at Service:76-95 logs a warning and continues; no rethrow for D365ClaimsChallengeException.
findings.impact: Claims challenge never reaches the client (no 401 + WWW-Authenticate); failures return partial calendars as success.
findings.fix: Remove the catch, or rethrow D365ClaimsChallengeException and let real errors propagate.

findings.evidence: QueryRecordsAsync(D365EntityNames.Workers, filter: ...) at Service:52-54 passes no select argument, while only PersonnelNumber and Name are read.
findings.impact: Full Workers rows fetched per call; wasted D365 load and violates service protection rule.

findings.issue: Fetches all leave rows for the whole team then slices in memory; no $top/$skip, no perPage+1 over-fetch.
findings.evidence: entries accumulated from every worker (Service:64-93), then Skip/Take at Service:99-103; HasNextPage derived from entries.Count at Service:115.
findings.impact: Page size does not bound D365 work or memory; cost grows with team size and range.
findings.fix: Push paging to D365 via QueryRecordsPagedAsync with perPage+1 over-fetch.

findings.issue: Skip/Take is applied before OrderBy, so pages are slices of an unsorted list that are only sorted afterwards.
findings.evidence: .Skip(...).Take(...).OrderBy(e => e.LeaveDate).ThenBy(...) at Service:99-104; entries are in worker order.
findings.impact: Page 2 can hold earlier dates than page 1; calendar is not globally ordered by date.
findings.fix: Order by date and worker name before Skip/Take.

findings.issue: Inclusive To date filtered with StartDate lt {to}T00:00:00Z, so leave on the last day is excluded.
findings.evidence: Query.To is documented as inclusive last day (DTO:8); filter uses lt {to}T00:00:00Z at Service:70.
findings.impact: Leave starting on the final day of the requested range never appears; incomplete calendar.

findings.issue: Cache key omits LeaveTypeCode although it changes the filtered result.
findings.evidence: GetTeamLeaveCalendarCacheKey(manager, from, to, page, perPage) at CacheKeys:58-59; the filter adds Type eq at Service:73.
findings.impact: A filtered request can return a cached differently-filtered page for 60s.

findings.issue: Controller wraps the service call in try/catch and returns BadRequest with raw exception text.
findings.evidence: try ... catch (ValidationException ex) { return BadRequest(ex.Message); } at Controller:33-41; GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware already maps ValidationException to 400.
findings.impact: Bypasses the standard 400 error shape and violates the no try/catch in controllers rule.
findings.fix: Remove the try/catch and let middleware handle ValidationException.

findings.issue: New D365 calls added without a docs/d365-calls update.
findings.evidence: Diff contains no docs/d365-calls/*.md file though Service:52 and Service:78 add Workers and LeaveApprovedRequests calls.
findings.impact: D365 call documentation drifts from the code.

findings.issue: Per-manager paged list cached without TrackChildKey.
findings.evidence: _cacheService.Set(cacheKey, ...) at Service:120-123 with no TrackChildKey for a manager parent key.
findings.impact: Cached pages cannot be invalidated as a group for a manager.
findings.fix: Call TrackChildKey with a manager parent key.

findings.issue: Only the happy path is tested: no cache hit, D365 error, last-day, paging or leave-type filter test.
findings.impact: Defects F4, F7, F8 and F9 are undetected by the suite.
findings.fix: Add cache-hit, D365-error, last-day, paging and filter tests.

findings.issue: DateTime.Parse of a Z-suffixed timestamp converts to server local time before DateOnly conversion.
findings.evidence: DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Parse(GetString(r, StartDate), InvariantCulture)) at Service:89 without AdjustToUniversal.
findings.impact: On a non-UTC host a leave date can shift by a day.

findings.issue: Endpoint triggers heavy D365 fan-out with no stated rate-limit policy intent.
findings.impact: Default global limit only; heavy endpoint can drain the per-user D365 budget.

findings.issue: CancellationToken is not passed to any D365 QueryRecordsAsync call.
findings.evidence: Both QueryRecordsAsync calls (Service:52, Service:78) omit cancellationToken.
findings.impact: Cancelled requests keep issuing D365 calls.
findings.fix: Pass cancellationToken if the signature allows.

findings.issue: Stray e2e stale C3..C6 comments left at end of DTO file.
findings.evidence: Four comment lines at DTO:29-32 carry no information.
